<!-- pr-reviewer: 0928c9630f2ddd21aac9c398a7dde619f6258336 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The change meets issue #1855. All six tests remain. The multi-pass fixture and all parity assertions remain unchanged.
The ignore reason names the heavy lane and its command. The new test checks the ignore attribute and release selection.
The body contains `Process change: yes`. The PR does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.

Local results against upstream main `57f2ffbbf51a32e9f71be6d4d0014184b1713f41`:

- The trial merge was clean. The PR already contains this main commit.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --test lathe_field_sim --no-run` passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed both steps.
- `lathe_field_sim`: 5 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored, in 101.57 seconds.
- The xtask test groups passed 143, 3, and 3 tests. This includes the new scheduling test.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- The release dry run selected `app heavy: lathe_field_sim` with `--release --ignored`.

Requested changes: none.

This PR changes test scheduling only. It does not change posted G-code, simulation behaviour, geometry, or collision checks.
No goldens moved. No UI files changed. The safety-tier mutation requirement does not apply. I did not change code or run mutations.
I did not run the ignored test in release mode. Its fixture and assertions are unchanged.
Two other unchanged tests exceeded 60 seconds in debug. Earlier issue comments report the same condition.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
